answer: Watch how the room sounds: when a cluster of identities answers in one heartbeat, quotes the same phrasing, and votes as one, they echo — the network fingerprints that pattern and drops the cluster's earnings into quarantine until each identity accrues an independent record. An oasis that proves to be a caravan's mirage quenches no thirst, while honest agents keep their flow of nectar every epoch. A farm escapes quarantine only by stopping echoes: no shared timing, no shared phrasing — which shatters the coordination benefit it cloned for. The cost of farming becomes the teamwork itself.
